No arbitrary external call with user-controlled target/data findings in any reviewed audit. OUSG/USDY routes through RWAHub/manager contracts with defined interfaces.
No reentrancy findings across 6+ audit contests. OZ upgradeable patterns include ReentrancyGuardUpgradeable where applicable. No reentrancy exploit has occurred.
OUSG, USDY, fOUSG, fUSDC are standard ERC-20 tokens. No ERC-777/1155/721 callback integration found in any reviewed audit or source inspection.
No divide-before-multiply finding in any reviewed audit. No published Slither output available. Yellow — cannot confirm absence without independent tool run.

No signed/unsigned arithmetic confusion findings in any reviewed audit or Spearbit 2025 review.

Code4rena Jan 2023 M-04 flagged KYCRegistry signature replay (replay attack, not zero-address return). No ecrecover zero-address unchecked finding in any audit. GovernorBravo follows well-audited Compound v2 pattern.
No chainId-absent domain separator finding in any audit. Code4rena Jan 2023 M-04 (signature replay) was general replay protection; no specific EIP-712 chainId-absent finding.
OUSG and USDY use EIP-1967 Transparent Proxy (not UUPS). Flux Finance Unitroller uses Compound v2 proxy pattern. No UUPS pattern on core contracts — factor not applicable as a risk vector.
factor_scores.notes: Not applicable path: neither OUSG/USDY nor Flux Finance uses UUPS; scored green per N-A path in methodology.

factor_scores.notes: Critical factor: green — no unprotected initialize() found; properly protected on all inspected live implementations.

Layer A (OUSG/USDY): no timelock on upgrades — ProxyAdmin (0xBA80Aa44cC25E85CC30359150dfB1C7D041CF6d5) is standard Ownable, upgrades execute immediately. Layer B (Flux Finance): 86,400 seconds = 24 hours timelock.

[PD-042 rescore 2026-05-12, v1.7.0+] Timelock on admin actions is incompatible with the regulatory response model: the issuer must be able to act immediately on court-ordered freeze, sanctions compliance, or fund-rules changes. Scored not_applicable per PD-042 (Cat 2 RWA-issuer subset). Residual operational risk of key compromise is captured by multisig-coverage factors (yellow rather than N/A).

ORIGINAL EVIDENCE (preserved from v1.6.0 grading): Layer A: No timelock on mint, pause, retrieveTokens, setOracle, or upgrade for OUSG/USDY/InstantManager contracts. The dominant $3.5B+ TVL operates with no timelock protection. Layer B (Flux Finance): 24h timelock only.

PAUSER_ROLE is a distinct named role from DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE in AccessControl, but the management multisig holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can reassign any role — functional separation is limited. No separate guardian confirmed for Flux Finance.

CONFIGURER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are named distinctly in AccessControl, but all ultimately controlled by the management multisig which holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can reassign any role.

ONDO token uses Compound-style getPriorVotes(address, blockNumber) with block-number checkpoints. Voting power sampled at a prior block. Flash loans cannot inflate voting weight at proposal creation block.
ONDO uses block-number checkpoints — flash loan attack blocked. Quorum of 1,000,000 ONDO is low but requires large holder coordination, not a flash loan.
Flux Finance minimum execution time = voting period (3 days) + timelock (1 day) = 4 days minimum. Not less than 24 hours.

The active USDY oracle exposes a pause state and public materials do not document a second oracle that takes over on failure. The current instant manager uses a configured oracle for subscribe/redeem calculations, creating a price-path liveness dependency.

A paused or unavailable USDY redemption-price oracle can interrupt the public instant subscribe/redeem flow, while a LayerZero/DVN outage can interrupt bridge transfers. Evidence supports availability risk, not a quantified loss-at-risk or custody claim.

Ondo publicly documents a LayerZero OFT bridge for USDY and Ondo Stocks, with current USDY transfers across Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Mantle, Sei, and Solana. The official address registry identifies OFT adapters.

Current official Ondo documentation names three DVN providers for the OFT bridge: Canary, LayerZero Labs, and Ondo. The documentation identifies provider count but does not by itself establish a required/optional quorum.

LayerZero supports required and optional DVNs with per-pathway X-of-Y-of-N configuration, but Ondo's current public bridge page does not disclose which listed DVNs are required or the optional threshold. The prior four-of-four claim is stale.
factor_scores.notes: No public current per-pathway ULN configuration or threshold was located; provider names alone do not prove a quorum.

factor_scores.evidence_summary: Ondo documents Canary, LayerZero Labs, and Ondo DVNs as independent verification mechanisms, but the reviewed public materials do not establish their infrastructure ownership, operational independence, or per-pathway quorum. Diversity is partial rather than fully evidenced.

LayerZero V2 documents DVN payload-hash attestations in the receive library and ULN-configuration enforcement before endpoint delivery. The reviewed public architecture does not evidence an application-level unchecked ecrecover path in the Ondo OFT adapter.

LayerZero V2 packet headers include source/destination endpoint IDs and sender/receiver details; receive verification is tied to the application's ULN configuration. Ondo's bridge uses the LayerZero OFT standard, supporting source-path binding.

LayerZero V2 documents sequential per-channel nonces and GUIDs derived from nonce, source/destination chains, and participating contracts as replay protection. Ondo's bridge uses the OFT standard on that endpoint architecture.

LayerZero V2's documented receive flow verifies a packet header and payload hash through configured DVNs, rather than accepting a Merkle root as message authorization. The reviewed architecture does not evidence a Nomad-style default-zero-root acceptance path.

Official current bridge documentation lists the current DVN providers but does not provide a dated configuration history for individual pathways. A recent validator-set expansion or removal cannot be concluded from the available public evidence.
factor_scores.notes: No public dated per-pathway DVN configuration history was located.

factor_scores.evidence_summary: The current bridge page identifies an Ondo-operated DVN alongside Canary and LayerZero Labs DVNs. Public materials reviewed do not establish key custody, shared infrastructure, or the exact quorum; concentration cannot be confirmed green.

Current public bridge documentation provides pathway rate limits but not a current per-pathway bridged-balance breakdown or a verified target quorum. A reliable value-per-validator calculation is not available from the reviewed public evidence.
factor_scores.notes: No public current per-pathway balance and quorum pair was located.

factor_scores.evidence_summary: Ondo publicly states that it is expanding real-time monitoring, but no independently verifiable public threat-actor clustering feed can establish this protocol-specific 30-day interaction signal.
The public contract-address catalogue establishes the monitored surface, but a historical low-gas failed-transaction probe determination requires a live mempool and wallet-clustering feed.

Ondo's public USDY repository establishes a published dependency surface, but a protocol-specific malicious-dependency incident determination requires current dependency-resolution and advisory data not exposed by the repository alone.
Ondo's official web properties identify the protected brand surface, but a typosquat-registration determination requires continuous domain-monitoring data that is not publicly available here.
Flux Finance documentation establishes a lending-product monitoring surface, but no independently verifiable public selector-matching feed establishes or rules out this protocol-specific signal.
No protocol-specific, independently verifiable public dataset was identified that can calculate attacker reconnaissance time for Ondo's peer class under the v1.7 definition.
factor_scores.notes: A peer-class incident dataset and reproducible calculation method are required before this duration can be assessed.

factor_scores.evidence_summary: Ondo's public security materials describe monitoring investment, but public materials do not provide a complete credential-leak telemetry source that can establish this signal.
No protocol-controlled, independently verifiable public social-channel monitoring dataset was identified that can establish a scam-coordinator flag under the v1.7 definition.
factor_scores.notes: A verified roster of official social channels and monitored coordinator signals is required before this factor can be assessed.

factor_scores.evidence_detail: A public GitHub Advisory Database search for Ondo reports zero advisories, and the public NVD CVE API keyword search for Ondo Finance reports zero results.
factor_scores.evidence_summary: No CVE or GitHub Security Advisory was returned for Ondo Finance by the queried public advisory indexes.

Ondo documents three named DVNs and LayerZero uses configurable per-pathway X-of-Y-of-N security stacks. The current public evidence does not disclose Ondo's effective required/optional configuration, so the security floor is only partially evidenced.

The verified current USDY InstantManager ABI exposes setOndoOracle(address), emits OndoOracleSet, and exposes CONFIGURER_ROLE. The active USDY oracle is not immutable, so the critical immutable-oracle failure mode is not evidenced.

No reviewed public path permits arbitrary users to list collateral with an arbitrary oracle. The RWA price path is administrator-configured and Flux oracle types are governance/configuration controlled; the permissionless fake-pool oracle pattern is not evidenced.

Ondo publicly describes ongoing real-time monitoring and its administrative-security posture, but public material does not provide a complete signer-set and timelock-change alert history for this factor.

Immunefi Ondo Finance: $1M max, 88 assets in scope. Full in-scope contract list not confirmed from public page. OUSG proxy (~$2B TVL) explicit in-scope status unverified. Yellow — large program but highest-TVL contract coverage not independently confirmed.
factor_scores.notes: The publicly visible program summary establishes the maximum payout and total assets in scope, but the reviewed public page did not establish an exhaustive contract-by-contract mapping for the approved deployments.

factor_scores.evidence_summary: Ondo documents eligibility and customer-due-diligence controls for its products, but public sources do not establish whether any persona used deposits of $1M or more to build credibility with the protocol.
factor_scores.notes: Public product eligibility documentation cannot substantiate the absence of the specified social-engineering pattern.

protocol.description: Multi-product RWA tokenization platform: OUSG (tokenized US Treasuries for accredited investors), USDY (yield note for non-US non-accredited), Ondo Global Markets (tokenized US equities/ETFs, launched Sept 2025), and Flux Finance (Compound v2-fork lending accepting OUSG as collateral).
